window_policy: Three consecutive 1M-retired-instruction endpoints with positive cumulative saving establish recovered startup cost. A separate positive-window streak is descriptive only. Frozen attainment uses window IPC >=99% of same-H frozen i1m for three windows. Report first qualifying endpoint and third-window confirmation. Crossing samples retain actual retirement counts; reference cycles normalized for a differing final retirement group. Interval quality uses legacy counter deltas, not issue-cohort success.
